$comment: Single source of truth for the agency SDK surface. Both clients, the README reference tables, both llms.txt files and the manifest tests read this file. kind: endpoint = one HTTP call, helper = client-side composition, local = no network, ws = WebSocket.

methods.name: getAccount
methods.summary: Your plan, per-minute limit, bulk check size and evaluation end date. Cached 5 minutes.

methods.name: listRegions
methods.summary: Every ranked region with its code, label and live count, so you never hardcode region codes.

methods.name: findCreatorsToRecruit
methods.summary: Creators ranked in a region who are candidates to recruit, with your last known Backstage verdict per row.

methods.name: iterCreatorsToRecruit
methods.summary: Walks every page of findCreatorsToRecruit and yields rows; waits for the rate-limit reset when needed.

methods.name: isFreeToJoin
methods.summary: True when a recruit row's last known Backstage verdict is eligible. Not a live invite check.

methods.name: newCreators
methods.summary: Creators who recently appeared in a region's recruit pool, newest first, with 7 and 30 day earnings estimates.

methods.name: iterNewCreators
methods.summary: Walks every page of newCreators and yields rows.

methods.name: leagueDivisions
methods.summary: League divisions in a region (A1, B2 ...) with member counts.

methods.name: leagueMembers
methods.summary: Creators in one or more league divisions. Names hidden on lower plans: Sandbox sees 3 masked rows, Basic and Pro the top 10 offline names, Ultra and up everything.

methods.name: droppedOutCreators
methods.summary: Creators who ranked on a region's board recently and fell below the cutoff, with diamonds needed to re-enter. Names unmasked on Agency.

methods.name: leagueDropouts
methods.summary: Per league division, creators who dropped out of the top 99. Names unmasked on Agency.

methods.name: gamingDropouts
methods.summary: Gaming creators who fell off the gaming boards. Beta.

methods.name: boardHistory
methods.summary: Who entered, left and moved on a board over a window (2h and 6h on Sandbox, 12h and 24h on Pro, 3d and point-in-time on Ultra).

methods.name: leaderboard
methods.summary: A region's daily board (any key). Weekly, gaming and shopping need Agency; league needs Ultra.

methods.name: globalLeaderboard
methods.summary: The top creators of every region in one call.

methods.name: clubRankings
methods.summary: The clubs board for a region. Full list on Agency, 3-row preview below.

methods.name: popularLive
methods.summary: The Popular LIVE board for a region. Full list on Agency, 3-row preview below.

methods.name: gamingRankings
methods.summary: Gaming boards for a region, per game. Full list on Agency, 3-row preview below.

methods.name: liveCounts
methods.summary: How many creators are live right now, globally and per region.

methods.name: topGifters
methods.summary: The biggest gifters in a region over a rolling day, week or month. Masked on Pro and Ultra, unmasked on Agency.

methods.name: getCreator
methods.summary: A creator's region, current rank, board score and live state in one call.

methods.name: getCreatorProfile
methods.summary: Full profile: followers, likes, videos, verified, private, app language. Daily lookup quota per plan.

methods.name: findRenamedCreator
methods.summary: Finds the current handle of a creator who renamed, so a roster stays correct.

methods.name: resolveUserIds
methods.summary: Turns numeric TikTok user ids into handles.

methods.name: getCreatorSummary
methods.summary: Gifts, diamonds, gifters, battles, chat and likes for a creator over 1-90 days.

methods.name: getDailyDiamonds
methods.summary: Diamonds per UTC day from captured gifts, with a complete flag per day. A lower bound, not the Backstage payout figure.

methods.name: getCreatorGifters
methods.summary: Who sent a creator the most diamonds.

methods.name: getCreatorGifts
methods.summary: Which gifts a creator received, how many and from how many senders.

methods.name: getCreatorBattles
methods.summary: Battles with opponent, scores, result and duration.

methods.name: getCreatorChat
methods.summary: Chat messages from a creator's streams. Only for creators on one of your rosters.

methods.name: getCreatorActivity
methods.summary: Likes and viewer joins per day.

methods.name: getCreatorGoals
methods.summary: Stream goals with progress and top contributors.

methods.name: listRosters
methods.summary: Your rosters with member and live counts (max 50 rosters).

methods.name: createRoster
methods.summary: Creates a named roster.

methods.name: getRoster
methods.summary: A roster's creators with live flag, score, followers and diamonds, live first.

methods.name: deleteRoster
methods.summary: Deletes a roster.

methods.name: addToRoster
methods.summary: Adds creators (chunks of 200, max 1000 per roster). Gift and chat capture starts from that moment.

methods.name: removeFromRoster
methods.summary: Removes creators from a roster.

methods.name: rosterDiamonds
methods.summary: Diamonds per creator and in total for a roster or a list of handles. One request per creator.

methods.name: isLive
methods.summary: Is this creator live right now? true, false, or null when it could not be determined. Works with no key.

methods.name: isLiveDetailed
methods.summary: Same check with room id and cache flag.

methods.name: whoIsLive
methods.summary: Splits many creators into live, offline and unknown. Chunks to your plan's batch size (Basic 10, Pro 50, Ultra 100, Agency 200).

methods.name: watchLive
methods.summary: Polls your creators and fires live and end events. A failed check never ends a stream; an end needs two offline polls in a row.
methods.endpointNote: polling, one per creator; POST /webcast/bulk_live_check on Basic and up

methods.name: streamBigGifts
methods.summary: Real-time alerts for gifts of 1,000+ diamonds: global, one region (mode region, needs region), or one league division (mode league, needs league; region optional). Each alert carries the creator's league division in classType when known. Needs an active Agency subscription.

methods.name: getEligibility
methods.summary: The last invite verdicts your Backstage extension recorded for these creators. Does not run a new check.

methods.name: getEligibilityAccounts
methods.summary: Your connected Backstage accounts with cooldowns, plus roster and premium totals.

methods.name: listWebhooks
methods.summary: Your webhooks, plan limits and today's delivery quota.

methods.name: createWebhook
methods.summary: Sends signed events (live.start, live.end, more on higher plans) to your URL for chosen creators or rosters.

methods.name: updateWebhook
methods.summary: Changes a webhook's URL, events, creators, rosters or active state.

methods.name: deleteWebhook
methods.summary: Deletes a webhook.

methods.name: testWebhook
methods.summary: Sends a signed sample live.start to your URL and reports what it answered.

methods.name: verifyWebhook
methods.summary: Checks the X-Tiktool-Signature header against the raw body and your secret, rejects old timestamps, returns the typed event. No key needed.

methods.name: toDiscordMessage
methods.summary: Formats an event as a Discord message body.
